method.title: 法语字幕退出包络漏覆盖反例
method.trigger: 该源累积字幕退出时，按中点测得的区域未覆盖源字尾。
method.action: 分别记录源字完整进出场擦除包络和目标显示框，检查实际边界连续帧并保留旧质量否决。
method.failure_signature: 旧版源字RE与译文同屏；扩大源擦除范围后尾字消失，但局部接缝仍可见。
limitations: 一源法语见证；未证明全帧运动通过或修复干净。
现有接缝及主体、图形修复痕迹仍在。
Quoted observations do not prove causality or validate the proposed action; controller review required.
method.next_counterexample_test: 审查完整退出区间及正常播放，检查扩大包络是否引入新接缝。

record.hypothesis: Midpoint-only source bounding boxes can under-cover the outgoing cumulative source caption. This is a supported exact-source coverage failure; it does not prove a generally clean repair method.
record.lesson: On this exact source, save original text full enter/exit extent separately from target display bbox, inspect dense actual boundary frames and current normal playback, and hold the exact original-letter version until reviewed replacement exists.
observations: Actual old French encoded caption probe shows original green/black RE at the right edge simultaneously with target Dans le monde entier. Current native112–132 frame range removes that tail, with a thin seam/geometry step visible at116–119. Source erase envelope widened while target display placement retained.
limitations: One independent source, French witness only. No company acceptance, clean master, all-frame motion approval or cross-source inference.
Current local seams/body/graphic repair traces persist. Original negative reviews and quality holds remain.
record.next_action: Review this exact-source evidence before any advisory adoption; do not rewrite old midpoint review or broaden language/source scope.
